changelog: WinPreview v1.3.2 - Interface & Interaction Release: one Lucide-based icon system across every toolbar, panel and the media HUD; redesigned Settings with tab icons and readable rows; Settings and File info now reachable from every format, including folders, archives, certificates, shortcuts, images, PDFs, Office, SVG, Markdown, notebooks, fonts, code, spreadsheets, audio and video; a new More actions menu on the media transport HUD plus right-click on video; controls start visible, fade after 2.5 seconds, reveal on mouse movement and toggle on click everywhere; the HUD now sizes itself to its window so controls never clip; human sentence-case copy throughout; fixed file-info header, close icons and toolbar clipping.
